verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal-based AI coding agent, so IDE integration is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows no JetBrains plugin, no interactive diff viewing in an IDE, and no way to share a selected code range from the editor. The terminal `@` file-path attachment is a related but different feature and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
